newsitem.title: USA: Evans denies Equity Investors link.
newsitem.headline: Evans denies Equity Investors link.

text.p: Evans Environmental Corp said on Wednesday that it had no dealings with Equity Investors or Melvin Lloyd Richards, an alleged stock swindler.

"There is not now, and never has been, any contract or relationship of any kind between Evans Environmental and Melvin Lloyds Richards," Evans Environmental Chief Executive Officer Enrique Tomeu said, responding to an article in the October 28 issue of Barron's.
The article said Evans Environmental appeared on Equity Investors' Internet site of company profiles. The site, the article said, was sponsored by Richards.
"Until the Barron's article appeared, we had no knowledge that Evans was being discussed on Equity Investors' Web Site," Tomeu said.
Tomeu said the company had not paid any fees to either Equity Investors or Richards, and it did not know why Evans was included on the electronic site.
Tomeu said Evans would demand that Equity Investors remove Evans from its presentation,
Evans provides environmental consulting, management and laboratory services, plans to change its name to ECOS Group pending completion of its recent acquisition of American Remedial Technologies Inc.
